Independently authored regression for a public static Object-bounded method with one original T[][] argument and a T[] result. The variable-arity declaration receives the exact original matrix. Source and SDK profiles compile every emitted source and retain all original class/method identities, Signatures, access/Code roles and Exceptions. Four immutable caller routes exercise direct and checked matrix calls plus explicitly packed row arguments. Each profile covers 196 fresh JVM cases twice, eight wrong programs and six same-Code Signature controls. Observers check both array ranks, covariance/store failures, partial writes, callbacks, class initialization, opaque or aliased row results and late casts.
